ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels covering approximately 85% of the surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal tips covering approximately 15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity central mass spanning from the median notch to the sub-terminal margins; high-intensity white mottling and solid banding at the distal lateral tips of both lobes; scattered circular white pixel clusters (0.5-1% surface area) within the dark central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 55-degree interior angle and deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity and deeper indentations on the medial side of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: S-curve trajectory exhibiting concavity at the medial junction near the notch and transitioning to a broad convexity toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several distinct, circular high-contrast white clusters; one prominent cluster in the lower-central region of the left lobe and three smaller, scattered clusters on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct vertical high-contrast linear mark (approximately 30-40 pixels in length) located in the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular white scars/depressions likely resulting from barnacle detachment; jagged irregular edge geometry at the far left terminal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Small high-contrast white dot located near the upper-medial margin of the right lobe.
